args.reason: The DoD delivers capability beyond the declared goals. The PRD explicitly says historical storage and query features are outside its scope, yet the PRDR adds a persisted .faff/merge-gate-history/<pr>.jsonl log, an --explain timeline of every past evaluation, a --since filter and a --format toggle. Those are exactly historical storage and query. The Phase-1 claim that they are a natural extension of inspection contradicts the PRD text. Only the --dry-run item is within scope.
